experiment: X1-v2 bounded final exploration: inference-budget allocation
timing: Before any X1 fit, probe or score; before the holdout is opened. Supersedes x1_protocol.json (v1 kept unchanged).
status: Gates fixed in v2. Runner, host registry, assignment file and packages not yet built. Nothing launched.
question: Within a provisional compute budget, does spending it on extra seeds or larger ImageNet-1K backbones beat the frozen A_L pair, as a comparison of complete procedures?

incumbent.name: A_L
incumbent.source: runs/l1-primary-v1/analysis.json; predictions on all five folds already saved

recipe: Identical to L1/final-v2 for every new fit: 20 epochs, batch 32, AdamW backbone 1e-4 / head 1e-3, weight decay 0.01 with bias/1-D exclusions, 2 warm-up epochs then cosine, EMA 0.999 with buffer copy, AMP training, A1-light augmentation, GCE q=0.7, FP32 TF32-off evaluation, FP64 sigmoid, unchanged 54-condition suite, fresh named torchvision ImageNet1K_V1 weights.

S_seeds.purpose: Seed diversity for the frozen architectures
S_seeds.note: All five folds are new data for seed-29 models; no screen stage.
S_seeds.eligibility: Seed-29 members have no separate arm gate. Completing all five folds under the declared recipe makes them eligible for the final ensemble gate.

C_capacity_screen.purpose: Larger backbone of the same family
C_capacity_screen.gate: Versus same-family Tiny-GCE s17 on the same folds: original AUC and J0.4 strictly higher on both folds, mean delta J0.4 >= +0.005.
C_capacity_screen.promotion: At most one ConvNeXt size (larger mean delta J; if within 0.002, the smaller) plus swin_s if it passes.

C_capacity_confirm.jobs: Each promoted model, s17 gce_q07, folds 2,3,4
C_capacity_confirm.gate: Mean delta J0.4 versus same-family Tiny-GCE >= +0.003, at least 2 of 3 strictly positive, mean delta original AUC >= 0.

candidate_final_ensembles.rule: Equal logit mean of listed members. The seven named candidates are the complete X1 candidate set; nothing else is selectable. Only members that completed all five folds under the declared recipe (and, for capacity members, passed screen and confirmation) are eligible.

A_L3c.note: Changes architecture weighting to 2/3 ConvNeXt. Report the diagnostic (2*CT17 + ST17)/3 from existing logits alongside it; that diagnostic is not selectable.

compute_cap.status: Provisional compute cap. GFLOPs are model metadata, not latency. T4 runtime is unverified for every candidate, including A_L.
compute_cap.no_larger_ensembles: The v1 override admitting ensembles above the cap is withdrawn. X1 is limited to the seven named candidates.

final_choice_gate.versus_A_L: A candidate is eligible only if: mean delta J0.4 versus A_L >= +0.002 over five folds (inclusive); at least 4 of 5 folds strictly positive; mean delta original AUC >= 0 (inclusive); and, if it contains a capacity member, mean delta J0.4 > 0 over folds 2,3,4.
selection_steps: 1. Filter the six non-incumbent named candidates by the gate above.
2. Find the largest five-fold mean J0.4 among eligible candidates.
3. Keep candidates whose mean J0.4 is within 0.002 of that maximum (inclusive).
4. Choose the lowest total GFLOPs among them.
5. Exact remaining tie: fixed order CT_SS, CS_ST, A_L3c, CS_SS, A_L4, CB_ST.
6. No eligible candidate: A_L, which is the fallback and does not take part in steps 1-5.
7. Apply the timing gate to the chosen candidate.
final_choice_gate.reporting: Paired group bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 20261103, within fold, identical draws across candidates; reported, not gating. The +0.002 margin is a practical threshold, not a correction for repeated selection.

not_included_and_why.gce_q_tuning: q=0.7 was a single dose, but expected effect of re-tuning is small relative to the added selection optimism; revisit only if every X1 arm fails.
not_included_and_why.longer_or_shorter_schedule: No local mechanism; memorization is controlled by GCE.
not_included_and_why.input_resolution: Downsampling to 112 px did not hurt; fine detail is not the bottleneck.
not_included_and_why.augmentation_strength: Robustness proxy sits about 0.004 below original AUC; little to gain.
not_included_and_why.flip_TTA: Doubles inference cost; seeds are the stronger use of the same budget.
not_included_and_why.third_architecture_family: Three-family BCE ensemble added about +0.001; low value.
not_included_and_why.training_label_cleaning: Overlaps the GCE mechanism; risks removing hard correct examples.

devices.verified: One RTX 5060 Ti at <GPU_HOST> (<USER>), UUID GPU-4f7dd3a1-55b5-1d57-d0ad-00186da5363e.
devices.user_reported_unverified: Two more RTX 5060 Ti (.34, .68) for three in total, and five RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB (.31, .24, .19, .72, .45). Each must pass the read-only probe and resource readiness check before use.
devices.policy: Hardware and seed or model size are partly confounded: incumbent fits ran on the primary 5060 Ti, seed-29 fits are assigned to 4060 Ti hosts, and capacity fits use both families. PyTorch does not guarantee reproducibility across platforms. X1 compares complete procedures and does not attribute a gain solely to seed or size. Every receipt records device UUID, model, driver, library versions, precision flags, skipped AMP steps and initialization and recipe hashes. A fixed numerical compatibility fixture is run on each host to catch setup errors; it cannot show that training trajectories agree. The final stage runs on the primary 5060 Ti.

selection_limits: All five development folds already informed P1, P2 and L1. X1 adds candidates and therefore optimism. The stricter +0.002 final margin partly offsets this. The single holdout readout evaluates whichever procedure is frozen.

amends.reason: Accepts all five findings of gpt61-review-x1-plan-2026-11-01.md before any X1 fit or score exists.

timing_gate.stage: After the final choice, before writing the final-stage freeze and before opening H.
timing_gate.bundle: The chosen candidate built from its fold-0 development checkpoints (same architectures, member count and combination as the final procedure).
timing_gate.fixture: 3,000 distinct synthetic 224x224 JPEG files generated locally; no organizer images.
timing_gate.command: The complete intended CLI in fresh processes, FP32, all members, including startup, model loading, decoding and CSV writing.
timing_gate.measured_5060ti_rule: On the primary RTX 5060 Ti, worst of three fresh-process runs <= 60 s. A provisional safety rule chosen now; not T4 compliance.
timing_gate.optional_t4_rule: If the user provides a T4, the same command on the T4 with worst of three fresh-process runs <= 180 s replaces the 5060 Ti rule.
timing_gate.on_failure_or_unavailable: If the chosen candidate fails the applicable rule, take the next candidate in selection order that passes all gates and the timing rule; if none, keep A_L. If no T4 is available, apply the 5060 Ti rule and state in the report that T4 runtime is unverified. Never describe either as measured T4 compliance.
timing_gate.not_a_selection_step: Timing of final all-data weights in the release check is a release result, not another selection opportunity.

resource_readiness.when: After environment setup on each host and before any scored fit.
resource_readiness.what: For every assigned architecture/device pair: synthetic inputs at training batch 32 through forward, backward, AdamW state creation and EMA update under AMP and the 0.75 allocator cap; FP32 evaluation at batch 64; save and reload the checkpoint through the versioned CLI. Record peak allocated and reserved memory.
resource_readiness.on_failure: Stop that assignment and report it. No automatic batch-size, precision or accumulation change. A capacity candidate missing required folds under the declared recipe is withheld.
resource_readiness.environment: Record the full driver version and run an actual CUDA check in the pinned environment; GPU recognition alone is insufficient.
resource_readiness.not_evidence: Readiness checks are not scored fits and never selection evidence.

runner_contract: Do not edit deepfake_core.py, train_p1.py, train_l1.py or any final-v1/v2 file; final-v2 launch inputs must stay valid.

A versioned builder, optimizer grouping, bundle loader and CLI support convnext_small, convnext_base and swin_s together. Test that every trainable parameter is in exactly one optimizer group, head parameters get the head learning rate, and the one-output head survives save and reload.
Receipts bind source hashes, protocol hash, pool manifest, named weight file SHA-256, logical fit ID, attempt ID and assignment revision.

A disconnected collector reconnects to its durable job before any spare starts another attempt. Amendments never leave two hosts owning one logical fit. Duplicate committed receipts for one fit ID: the first committed receipt by timestamp wins, never the better score.

Every incoming prediction file passes canonical checks: exact unique IDs per fold, frozen labels and group IDs, canonical condition names and weights, saved probabilities equal FP64 sigmoid of saved logits.

If the final ensemble changes, final-v3 preserves final-v2 behaviour: atomic output replacement, accepted template flags, alias script, checkpoint reload, holdout interruption policy and release checks, while supporting the new members.
counts: Wave 1: 16 fits. Confirmation: 0-6. Final stage: 4, 6 or 8 fits. Total new training runs: 20-30. Timings are estimates until measured.
